items.description: Yellowstone National Park, primarily in Wyoming, is a vast wilderness area atop a volcanic hot spot. It is famous for its geothermal features, including Old Faithful geyser.
facts: Diverse wildlife including grizzly bears and wolves.

items.description: Walt Disney World Resort in Orlando, Florida, is the most visited vacation resort in the world. It features multiple theme parks, water parks, and entertainment complexes.
facts: Includes Magic Kingdom, Epcot, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom.

items.description: Everglades National Park in Florida protects the southern 20 percent of the original Everglades. It is a vast wetland ecosystem known for its unique wildlife, including alligators and panthers.
facts: Largest tropical wilderness in the US.

items.description: The Central Park Zoo is a small, but popular zoo located within Central Park in New York City. It houses a diverse collection of animals from various climates.
facts: Managed by the Wildlife Conservation Society.
Features polar bears, snow leopards, and red pandas.
A small but engaging urban zoo.

items.description: Denali National Park and Preserve in Alaska is home to North America's tallest peak, Denali (Mount McKinley). It encompasses six million acres of wild land.
facts: Peak of Denali stands at 20,310 feet.
Protected habitat for grizzly bears, moose, and caribou.

items.description: Glacier National Park in Montana is known for its dramatic glacial-carved terrain, historic Going-to-the-Sun Road, and pristine forests. It is often referred to as the 'Crown of the Continent'.
facts: Part of the Waterton-Glacier International Peace Park.
Home to a diverse array of plant and animal life.

items.description: Hersheypark is a family theme park located in Hershey, Pennsylvania. Originally created as a leisure park for Hershey's employees, it is now open to the public.
facts: Owned by Hershey Entertainment and Resorts Company.
Features roller coasters and water rides.

items.description: Olympic National Park in Washington State is renowned for its diverse ecosystems, including glaciated mountains, temperate rainforests, and rugged coastline.
The Shedd Aquarium in Chicago, Illinois, is one of the largest indoor aquariums in the world. It houses a collection of more than 32,000 animals.
facts: Home to beluga whales and sea otters.

items.description: Rocky Mountain National Park in Colorado features majestic mountain peaks, alpine lakes, and a variety of wildlife. Trail Ridge Road is a prominent scenic drive within the park.
facts: Highest national park in the US.
Famous for elk and bighorn sheep.
